products.text:
Type: shag diamond area rug
Use: softening the floor under seating; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: bohemian, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: plush shag pile, knotted tassel fringe
Colors: off-white, charcoal black lines
Shape: rectangular, irregular hand-drawn diamond lattice, thick fluffy pile, tasseled short ends, medium size
Feel: cozy, soft, relaxed
Goes with: leather and warm wood, white walls, black accents; Moroccan-inspired, Scandinavian or boho rooms

Type: wool floral runner rug
Use: covering a long narrow floor; hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: hand-tufted wool, multicolor tassel fringe
Colors: light cream, sage green, soft blue, taupe
Shape: long narrow runner, muted Persian-style vine and floral pattern with border, low textured pile, tasseled ends
Feel: gentle, warm, timeless
Goes with: medium wood floors, navy or white cabinetry, brass hardware; traditional or farmhouse rooms

Type: ombre wool area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: woven wool, fine ribbed texture
Colors: charcoal grey fading to warm beige
Shape: large rectangle, smooth horizontal gradient from light to dark, flat low pile, clean edges, substantial
Feel: calm, grounded, sophisticated
Goes with: grey upholstery, dark wood, natural baskets; modern or minimalist rooms

Type: criss-cross wool area rug
Use: defining a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: Scandinavian, bohemian, coastal
Materials: tufted wool, raised lines, tassel fringe
Colors: ivory white, soft dusty blue
Shape: rectangle, irregular hand-drawn grid lattice in raised pile, tasseled short ends, medium size
Feel: airy, relaxed, fresh
Goes with: charcoal sofas, weathered wood, plants, white walls; Scandinavian, coastal or boho rooms

Type: flatweave plaid runner rug
Use: covering a long narrow floor; hallway, bedroom, entryway
Style: farmhouse, traditional, rustic
Materials: flatwoven fabric, heathered texture
Colors: warm grey, ivory, red stripes, olive accents
Shape: long narrow runner, large tartan plaid with thin red and olive lines, thin flat weave, clean bound edges
Feel: cozy, homey, casual
Goes with: warm wood, navy cabinetry, herringbone floors; farmhouse or cottage rooms

Type: distressed damask area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: traditional, classic, glam
Materials: low-pile woven fabric, faded vintage finish
Colors: ivory, soft pink
Shape: large rectangle, all-over distressed damask scroll pattern, flat low pile, clean edges
Feel: romantic, soft, elegant
Goes with: light grey upholstery, warm wood, white walls; feminine traditional or shabby-chic rooms

Type: striped flatweave runner rug
Use: covering a long narrow floor; hallway, entryway, bedroom
Style: modern, rustic, contemporary
Materials: flatwoven fabric, fine pinstripe texture
Colors: dark brown, warm beige, grey
Shape: long narrow runner, wide horizontal bands with thin pinstripes, thin flat weave, clean edges
Feel: grounded, warm, casual
Goes with: white floors, rustic wood, natural straw, plants; modern rustic or coastal rooms

Type: adjustable black floor reading lamp
Use: reading light beside a chair or desk; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: matte black metal, brushed steel accents
Colors: matte black, silver
Shape: thin straight pole, small cylindrical pivoting head on short arm, square weighted base, slim and light
Feel: clean, functional, discreet
Goes with: grey or black furniture, white walls, steel accents; minimalist or modern rooms

Type: brass globe floor lamp
Use: ambient light beside a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, glam, art deco
Materials: gold-tone metal, white opal glass globe
Colors: warm gold, white
Shape: slim straight pole, short side arm holding hanging glass globe, round disc base, light and open
Feel: elegant, warm, airy
Goes with: velvet, walnut, white or dark walls; mid-century or glam rooms

Type: three-arm brass floor lamp
Use: ambient light beside seating; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, modern, retro
Materials: antique brass metal, warm wood-tone stem and base
Colors: antique brass, warm reddish brown
Shape: slim pole, three swiveling horizontal linear light bars at staggered heights, round disc base, tall and sculptural
Feel: sculptural, warm, playful
Goes with: walnut, leather, neutral walls; mid-century modern rooms
